title: Knightmare's Modpack
description: A collection of mods I normally use, Focused on improving vanilla while not straying too far from a perfect vanilla client
body:
THIS MODPACK WILL CRASH SERVER SIDE, Instead you are needed to cherry pick a few mods to work on the server, Cherry Pick the mods that arent client side, and make sure all dependencies are installed.

Hi:)

This is a collection of mods I normally use when playing

There are so many mods to explain manually so I will tell in brief categories what the mods do

This modpack is a fork of Faboulously Optimised so expect good performance, Nvidia Specific Users also get an advantage as Nvidium does significant boosts to performance for Nvidia GPU's

This modpack adds tons of QOL features like Anvil Restoration, Easy Shulker Boxes and FastQuit

This modpack has a few changes that I personally like like No Netherite Template, This mod also includes CustomSkinLoader, but feel free to remove it if you dont like it

This modpack supports automatic data pack loading for every world

It also makes your world look gorgeous visually(unless u are using Nvidium)

It also has Essential mod for easy Multiplayer

It includes Complimentary Shaders with Euphoria Patches with my settings(inspired by Vanilla Perfected), ofc if you want to use some other shader or no shader at all feel free to

Heres a link to my Vanilla Tweaks
https://vanillatweaks.net/share/#F3koCu

Also if you dont want Me as your Totem use this website to make it to any Minecraft skin
https://skinmc.net/totem
